reference.title: Scenario 7: Image inside a table cell
reference.shortdesc: Consider a Markdown table that contains images of the icons that represent the status indicators.

section.p: Consider a Markdown table that contains images of the icons that represent the status indicators.

entry.codeblock: | Status | Icon | Description | |---------|---------|---------| | Active | ![](images/active.png) | System operating normally | | Warning | ![](images/warning.png) | User attention required | | Error | ![](images/error.png) | System failure detected |

Status Icon Description
Active <image href="media/active.png"/> System operating normally
Warning <image href="media/warning.png"/> User attention required
Error <image href="media/error.png"/> System failure detected

section.p: Result:The converter preserves image references contained within table cells and generates DITA <image> elements inside the corresponding <stentry> elements. The table structure and image references are both maintained during conversion.
